reason: My shop already gets steady work from Instagram and WhatsApp and from people who know us. I don't see why I'd pay 10% of every job to a new app when my current channels work.
objection: I'd be giving a cut of every job to a platform, and I'd have to trust strangers sent by an app to pay me on time and not waste my technicians' time.
would_change_my_mind: Verified customers who are clearly ready to book, with a real track record of finished jobs and no monthly cost, at a level that clearly brings in work I wouldn't get otherwise.
